articles.summary: Petrol and diesel prices remained largely stable across major cities on November 4 after the Centre cut the petrol export duty to zero and raised the diesel export levy. Meanwhile, global oil prices fluctuated as traders assessed mixed signals on US-Iran peace talks amid tensions in the Middle East.
